batch_execute.description: Batch commands: elaborate computations STAY in sandbox, only summaries return to context

execute.description: Single-file analysis: set 'intent' to filter via semantic search, don't return raw data

index_policy.description: Keep knowledge base lean: only index documentation, skip tool outputs

workflows.research: query qmd → ctx_search → only summarize findings
workflows.implementation: read file → implement → write file (no indexing raw code)
workflows.debugging: ctx_batch_execute with intent + ctx_search for patterns

DO: Use ctx_batch_execute for complex research (all processing stays in sandbox)
Use ctx_search to recall prior work (not raw Read)
Use ctx_execute_file to analyze large files (intent filters output)
Set 'intent' on every execute call to enable semantic filtering
DONT: Use Read for large analysis (use execute_file + intent instead)
Call Read + process mentally (compute in sandbox, return summary)
Rely on conversation context for later sessions (use memory system)
